meta.name: Murder Is Easy
meta.description: England, 1954. On a train to London, Fitzwilliam meets Miss Pinkerton, who tells him that a killer is on the loose in the sleepy English village of Wychwood under Ashe. The villagers believe the deaths are accidents, but Miss Pinkerton knows otherwise — and when she’s later found dead on her way to Scotland Yard, Fitzwilliam feels he must find the killer before they can strike again.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A stranger's death leads Luke Fitzwilliam to the quiet village of Wychwood, where he is determined to prove that a series of tragic 'accidents' is in fact the work of a killer.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the village is shaken by another death, the discovery of a crucial piece of evidence blows the investigation wide open and leaves Luke Fitzwilliam questioning who he can trust.
